name: video_vfx
description: Applies one catalog effect to a clip. Call `video_vfx_list` first — `vfxId` comes from there, and so do the keys `parameters` accepts. Colour work belongs in `video_color_grade`, camera shake in `video_motion_shake`. Max 20s / 200 MB. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation. Max 20s, 200 MB.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

fps.description: Output frame rate, 1-60. Omit to keep the source rate.

parameters.description: Effect-specific settings. Valid keys are the ones `video_vfx_list` reports for this `vfxId`.
